We reaffirm our statements in the Interim Report concerning the proper construction of certificates authorizing service at New York City, Commercial Zones, 124 M.C.C. at 177-78. Effective administration of our rules will be aided greatly by an uniform interpretat on of the authority implied by certificates to serve "New York, N.Y.," "New York City," the "New York Exempt Zone," the "New York commercial zone as defined in 1 M.C.C. 665" (or any other particular decision), or the "New York, N.Y., commercial zone." In the future each of these service authorizations will be interpreted to mean that service to New York City and all points within 20 miles of its corporate limits is authorized.
